title: Capability Studio — complete online product delivery contract
intendedOutcome: OV3 generates, publishes and maintains the complete online Capability Studio: authoritative ecosystem discovery, five evidence-backed uses per selected subject, real estate capability generation/admission, explicit invocation, live canonical circuit observability and results/replay through one generic typed workflow.
sourceAuthorityPolicy: Owner intent establishes scope. JSON is the structured delivery manifest; Markdown is its generated human view. Canonical features establish behavioral obligations. Any disagreement fails definition validation. DSL and formal models derive from pinned features.

altitudes.name: Canonical feature
altitudes.responsibility: Establish the intended outcome and governing requirements.

altitudes.name: Scenario
altitudes.responsibility: Establish the Input → Event → Outcome obligation and its admissible conditions.

altitudes.name: Capability and profile schema
altitudes.responsibility: Establish structural, semantic, dependency, provider and authority contracts.

altitudes.name: Resolution and execution
altitudes.responsibility: Verify that admitted bindings and runtime behavior conform to those declared contracts.

altitudes.name: Flight-recorded evidence
altitudes.responsibility: Compare observed behavior and effects against the declared obligations, preserving what was actually demonstrated.

scope.overallCompletion: Every named ecosystem requires deployed profile qualification. Python-first is sequencing, not a waiver. Scope changes require a versioned owner-authorized contract revision.
scope.qualificationMinimum: For every required ecosystem, pin a nonempty finite subject set before qualification. Exercise all five supported use cases per subject through generation/admission/invocation/live/results, reuse/composition assessment, full deployed browser journey and successful/failed maintenance. Preserve exact coverage; the core process remains generic for other admissible user-selected sets.
scope.cloudBoundary: Use authorized sandbox resources with real verifiable effects and cleanup. Simulations do not qualify Azure/AWS delivery.
scope.runtimeBoundary: Ecosystem differs from kernel runtime. Profiles declare actual host/interpreter/package/ABI/authority requirements; no assumed cross-language handoff or installed packages.

qualityTargets.timingScope: Browser event receipt to painted state on the declared qualification target. Report network/provider latency separately; do not disguise long operations.
qualityTargets.performancePolicy: Record sizes, concurrency, latency and model cost/usage per profile; declare deadlines/retry bounds before execution and show incomplete/failed outcomes when exceeded.

dataContracts.policy: Closed objects; explicit nullability and finite states; immutable identity/revision pins; dynamic subject payloads validated against their pinned declared schemas.

modelPolicy.transportRule: ask-model is a transport. Jev/TypeSafe and DeepSeek/Gemini/OpenAI are model/provider choices. Typed roles require pinned input/output schemas and validation; names alone provide no type/authority guarantee.
modelPolicy.escalation: Unknown, conflicting, unsupported, schema-invalid or low-confidence decisions escalate. A versioned profile declares calibrated thresholds and independent evaluation evidence before automated triage.
modelPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: Declared deterministic verification and estate authority; model judgments remain advisory.

obligations.title: Catalog and top-five selection
obligations.requiredOutcome: Searchable catalog and five evidence-backed ranked uses for every selected subject.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Retain the exact selected subject set; never silently drop subjects.
A completed subject has five distinct supported use cases with unique ranks 1–5, rationale and source references.
Insufficient documented uses return INCOMPLETE with a shortfall, never fabricated filler.
Selection and source/version identity persist across navigation.

obligations.title: Canonical circuit
obligations.requiredOutcome: A selected use case becomes a reviewable candidate on the required topology.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Input/Given left, named Event and ordered Operations middle, Outcome/Then right, providers above numbered ports, Observation/Telemetry beneath.
Provider bindings and execution edges are distinct; identities and geometry match the pinned reference.
Scene navigation, zoom, search and inspection preserve candidate/revision selection.

obligations.title: Contract inspection
obligations.requiredOutcome: Readable input/outcome inspection backed by the actual canonical schemas.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Show types, required fields, constraints, defaults, units and null/absent semantics plus the full schema.
Displayed and invoked schema digests agree; changes create a new revision and update forms.

obligations.title: Provider inspection
obligations.requiredOutcome: Users see actual provider identities, runtime requirements and availability evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Show binding, dependency closure, runtime/host requirements, compatibility and conformance/admission evidence.
Proposed, resolved, admitted, refused and unknown are distinct; labels, scores and caller claims cannot supply availability.

obligations.title: Review and refinement
obligations.requiredOutcome: Annotations and composition changes produce reviewable candidate revisions.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Annotations and changes bind to exact candidate revisions; history remains visible.
Refinement creates a new revision; an approval cannot transfer silently to changed bytes.

obligations.title: Generate and admit
obligations.requiredOutcome: Generate creates real estate capability artifacts and executable admitted capabilities.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Author canonical feature before pinned DSL; expose contracts, bindings, dependencies, proofs and actual downloadable artifacts.
Compile, preflight, prove and admit through declared governance with exact revision identities and visible refusals.
No mocked generation, canned outputs or frontier implementation substitutes; only admitted resolved capabilities enable Invoke.

obligations.title: Invoke
obligations.requiredOutcome: Explicit host-authorized invocation of a newly generated capability returns a genuine run.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Synchronized forms and JSON represent the same schema-validated input, defaults and optional fields.
An explicit authorized Invoke returns a run ID; page load, navigation, inspection and replay cannot execute.
Idempotency and ambiguous-response recovery prevent unintended duplicates; credentials remain in the host boundary.

obligations.title: Live observability
obligations.requiredOutcome: Actual execution animates live on the canonical circuit.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Every displayed occurrence maps to the selected run/root/attempt/operation/occurrence/cursor and observed event.
Show actual timing, nested circuits, timeline and telemetry; no invented progress or stretched durations.
Expose observation gaps and never switch the selected run silently.

obligations.title: Results and replay
obligations.requiredOutcome: Actual output, receipts and promise-versus-execution comparison with functional replay.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Show actual results, selected outcome, retained receipts and declared-versus-observed findings.
Pause, step, speed, backward seek and return-to-live work.
At cursor k, facts first observed after k are invisible; replay has no provider effects.

obligations.title: Failure and recovery
obligations.requiredOutcome: Truthful execution states and recovery across failure and disconnection.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Distinguish ready, running, completed, failed, disconnected and replay.
Disconnect retains last observed facts and the gap, without inferring completion, failure or cancellation.
Reconnect follows the same run; duplicates, reordered and missing events cannot create false success.
Any offered cancellation uses declared authority and confirmed results; closing a view does not cancel.

obligations.title: Professional connected product
obligations.requiredOutcome: The entire deck is one navigable responsive online application.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Preserve the navy SideFX rail, light workspace, restrained indigo actions, readable typography and canonical dark circuit.
Deep links, browser history, stable selection, keyboard focus and loading/empty/error states work across all screens.
Qualify 1440×900, 1024×768 and 390×844 layouts without obstructed required controls.
No disconnected screenshots, dead navigation or decorative Generate/Invoke/replay controls.

obligations.title: OV3 agency and reasoning
obligations.requiredOutcome: OV3 owns generation and correction, using each reasoning mode strategically.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: One objective drives discovery, planning, supply, correction, publication, readback and verification without another frontier command.
Deterministic checks handle known rules; general reasoning handles novel semantics/design; System One handles bounded typed classification/ranking/uncertainty.
Models remain advisory; record provider/model, decision profile, typed inputs/outputs, evidence, uncertainty, escalation and available cost/token/latency metrics.

obligations.title: Maintenance
obligations.requiredOutcome: OV3 delivers subsequent requirement changes through the same declared process.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Retain the change; revise feature/scope before DSL and dependent artifacts; invalidate affected proofs.
Regenerate, publish and read back the changed product; verify changed and unchanged obligations.
Prove successful and failed maintenance without frontier implementation; failures preserve the last verified usable release; retries/resume are idempotent.

obligations.title: Complete review delivery
obligations.requiredOutcome: The owner receives the working product and independently verified complete review package.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Resolve exact required obligation, criterion and ecosystem-instance sets from the retained contract, never a caller subset or count.
Require attributed proofs, published-byte readback, deployed user journeys, initial/maintenance agency and every required profile qualification.
OV3 validates obligation completeness before review submission; missing, failed or inconclusive required evidence prevents fulfillment.
Automatic verification, review submission and owner-reserved acceptance are distinct states.

obligations.title: Online ecosystem discovery
obligations.requiredOutcome: Authoritative online sources are discovered, enumerated and version-pinned.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Record requested/resolved URLs, ecosystem/subject/version, retrieval time, content digests and provenance; enumerate the selected population exactly.
Handle pagination, rate limits, unavailable/changed sources and version conflicts visibly with bounded retries.
Retrieved text is evidence, never execution authority; refresh creates a new revision and invalidates dependent claims.

obligations.title: Generic repeatability
obligations.requiredOutcome: The same core and contracts work across Python, Node, C#, Java/Spring Boot, Go, Azure and AWS.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Qualify every named ecosystem through profile-bound discovery, top-five ranking, generation, admission, invocation, live/replay and maintenance.
Declare catalog/documentation adapters, dependencies, host/runtime/provider requirements, authority and verification bindings.
Ecosystem does not imply a kernel language; adding profiles must not fork the product workflow.
Actual selected subject sets are pinned; no omitted ecosystem or subject can be waived silently.

obligations.title: Online deployment and operation
obligations.requiredOutcome: Deliver an authenticated deployed product with recovery and observability.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Supply the actual authorized product URL, release/environment/profile identity and authenticated browser readback.
Prove session expiry/recovery, owner isolation and authorized invocation on the deployed target.
Health, diagnostics, release history, rollback and last-verified release recovery are usable.
A redirect, local preview, merged PR or isolated renderer is insufficient product acceptance.

obligations.title: Definition-complete delivery contract
obligations.requiredOutcome: OV3 validates a durable complete contract before implementation.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Pin Markdown/JSON, owner/deck/topology/strategy sources, obligations, flights, payloads, gates and formal properties.
Check completeness, consistency, coverage and bounded feasible supply/repair paths; reconcile independent semantic review.
Only an authoritative OV3 definition receipt for exact bytes enables product flights; local/advisory checks cannot open the gate.

obligations.title: Flight-planned delivery
obligations.requiredOutcome: Every obligation has a declared delivery, verification and repair path.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Plans define prerequisites, typed steps, capability bindings, expected evidence, failures and compensation.
Materialize concrete estate flight revisions, inputs and mappings; resolve dependencies and satisfy current exact-digest clearance before executing.
Preserve deviations and failed attempts; repairs are new reviewed revisions and do not inherit incompatible approvals.

obligations.title: Formal verification
obligations.requiredOutcome: Canonical propositions, refinement and invocation evidence are connected across all five altitudes.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Specify preconditions, transition relations, postconditions, effects, refusals and progress assumptions.
Prove scoped acceptance soundness/non-vacuity, refinement, guarded data flow, routing/bounds and evidence attribution.
Pin checker/model/property/dependency identities, assumptions, bounds and certificates/counterexamples.
A bounded abstraction or example test is not an unbounded theorem or proof of a deployed implementation.

obligations.title: Typed workflow contracts
obligations.requiredOutcome: Every workflow edge and inference boundary has a versioned closed data contract.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Define scope, profile, source, ranking, decisions, candidates, artifacts, invocation/events/replay, publication, flight, proof and gate payloads.
Preserve identities, enum/range/cardinality, nullable/absent distinctions, ordering and immutable source/artifact pins.
Prove guarded mappings satisfy downstream preconditions; reject unknown fields, incompatible revisions and malformed responses.

obligations.title: Reusable capability supply
obligations.requiredOutcome: OV3 cultivates missing mechanics as durable reusable estate supply.

acceptanceCriteria.predicate: Discover actual admitted contracts before selecting reuse, composition or a new mechanic.
New supply follows feature → scenario → schema/profile → declared implementation → proof/admission → fresh recorded invocation.
Use isolated rehearsals and declared rollback/compensation; every unresolved responsibility has an owner, bounded investigation and supply/repair path.

formalVerification.proofScopeRule: Finite abstraction results stay scoped to that abstraction. Universal implementation theorems require independently checked proofs. Every certificate pins subject, checker, assumptions, bounds and dependencies.
formalVerification.invalidation: Changes to scope/features/contracts/graphs/providers/resolvers/host profiles/sources invalidate affected proofs; only unchanged dependency closures may reuse scoped results.
formalVerification.preparationBoundary: P01 applies to PRODUCT steps. Verifier preparation is separately constrained by G-PREPARATION and existing admission authority; no bootstrap step can claim product fulfillment or self-authorize.

deliveryClosure.preGateEvidence: G-OBLIGATION checks all 70 criterion predicates using pre-gate product/proof evidence. C14.3/C14.4 are verified as implemented ordering/state invariants with attributed controls, not by requiring the gate to cite its own future receipt.

deliveryClosure.objectiveFulfillment: Requires authoritative OBLIGATIONS_COMPLETE plus verified DeliveryClosureReceipt and matching publication/review digests; gate passage alone is not owner delivery.
deliveryClosure.failure: Submission or closure failure leaves objective UNFULFILLED; repair FP13 without duplicating external delivery and reuse only unchanged valid gate dependencies.

flightMaterialization.approvalRule: Existing authorization persists. Ask only where current live policy reserves a new exact-digest decision. Never forge, weaken or reclassify authority.
flightMaterialization.bootstrapBoundary: Contract authoring, local proofs and assisted OV3 reviews are explicit bootstrap work, not evidence of autonomous product operation.
flightMaterialization.adapterRule: Candidate primitives are composition ingredients, not promises of matching request schemas. Resolve the actual declared schema; materialize a compatible declared adapter/composition and prove all JSON-pointer mappings. Never send an abstract step payload directly to an incompatible primitive. Refuse unresolved bindings.
flightMaterialization.preparationRule: FP00 uses G-PREPARATION. Only PRODUCT flights use G-FLIGHT. No candidate evaluator self-admission or retrospective gate approval.

defaultInvestigationBounds.deadlinePolicy: Materialization pins a concrete UTC deadline within 8 hours of the first attempt; applicable shorter host/provider limits also apply. Bound exhaustion is visible and does not authorize retries.

changeControl.identity: Stable contractId, monotonic revision; hash exact UTF-8 bytes externally, no self-hash.
changeControl.projection: Markdown is generated from JSON; separate bundle manifest pins JSON/Markdown/schemas/features/formal artifacts without self-reference.
changeControl.scopeChange: Retain original/revised scope and authority; rerun definition gate, affected proofs and flight clearance. Never silently alter an active objective.
changeControl.legacyStatus: Earlier C01-C14 feature/DSL and renderer flights are reusable partial artifacts, not this generic product delivery authority; FP01 reconciles their mappings.

coverageExpansion.globalCriteria: All criteria of C18-C22 plus core architecture/agency criteria of C12.
coverageExpansion.profileCriteria: All criteria C01-C17 instantiated for every required ecosystem qualification profile.
coverageExpansion.subjectUseCaseCriteria: C01 requires five uses per selected subject; C06-C09 require each selected use case to generate/admit/invoke/observe. Qualification exercises all five uses for each subject in its pinned finite qualification set.
coverageExpansion.pinning: Before a qualification flight starts, retain its subject/use-case/criterion-instance manifest and digest. The final verifier independently expands and compares exact sets; callers cannot shrink them.
coverageExpansion.universalityLimit: Finite qualification demonstrates those instances. Generic architecture/refinement establishes the parameterized process under declared source/provider constraints; it is not a claim that every possible external API or library has been tested.
coverageExpansion.matrixExecution: Python is the initial FP02-FP10 instance. FP11 materializes additional profile-scoped instances of FP02/FP04-FP10 using pinned shared FP00/FP01/FP03 supply. Child dependencies refer to the same profile instance, not back to FP11; this is finite expansion, not recursive flight execution.
coverageExpansion.pythonQualification: The initial Python FP02/FP04-FP10 instance is the Python qualification. FP11 reads its exact pinned receipt and qualifies the other six ecosystems. Exactly one selected qualification instance per ecosystem counts; repair attempts retain lineage and never count as extra ecosystems.

semanticChecks.rankedUses: Per selected subject, require five unique useCaseId values and unique normalized titles for COMPLETE, exact ranks 1..5, supported source evidence and independent semantic distinctness review. Duplicate IDs/titles are rejected deterministically; different wording alone does not prove distinct meaning.
semanticChecks.invocation: Atomically scope idempotencyKey to caller authority, capability revision and requestDigest. Same key/same request resolves to the same run; different request returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT with no new run. After ambiguous delivery, read the admission ledger by key before retry; retry only with the original key and identical digest. Unknown admission stays INCONCLUSIVE.
semanticChecks.events: operationId is canonical graph operation identity; stepId is flight step. The retained observation ledger assigns unique increasing cursor per run; retransmission must have identical event digest and is deduplicated. logicalOrder is the declared causal/topological projection order, never wall-clock authority. Replay filtering uses first-observed cursor. GAP declares missing range (or unknown end), reason and affected run; no synthesized completion. Displayed occurrences must join retained run/root/step/operation/attempt/occurrence and graph/provider pins.
semanticChecks.replay: Resolve recordingRef independently for the exact run. visibleEventRefs equals the ordered retained observations with first-observed cursor <= selected cursor, including gap markers. Projection is a pure function of pinned recording/cursor/profile and cannot invoke providers. Verify effect absence at mediation boundary and runtime prefix evidence; finite model results alone do not prove live replay.
semanticChecks.browserReadback: BrowserReadback must identify DEPLOYED_TARGET, authenticated authorized principal reference, requested/final URL and origin matching the retained publication, release digest and actual bytes. A preview, proxy substitution, screenshot alone or merged source cannot pass. JourneyReceipt must reference that matching readback and independently observed runtime evidence. No credentials in evidence.
semanticChecks.refinement: P05/P06/P13 require independently checked refinement certificates or translation validation against pinned executable semantics and explicit abstraction/guard/mapping, plus matching runtime attribution. Bounded models alone and runtime-only observations cannot satisfy refinement. State all finite domains and assumptions; outside supported domains refuse or remain INCONCLUSIVE. C20.2 cannot pass with an UNPROVED/BOUNDED_MODEL_CHECKED-only required refinement.
semanticChecks.supplyBounds: Every unresolved responsibility declares reachable supplyFlightId, repairFlightId, maxAttempts and deadlineAt. At the first exhausted bound, stop dependent work, retain Finding and mark BLOCKED_OR_UNFULFILLED_WITH_FINDINGS. No silent extension; any new bounds require a new reviewed plan revision.
semanticChecks.topology: TopologyArtifact names canonical input/event/operations/outcome/observation nodes and providers, numbered port bindings, distinct execution/binding/observation edges, and layout profile. Validate identities/joins, input left of event/operations left of outcome, providers above and observation below. Affine zoom/pan and responsive viewport transformations preserve topology; compare normalized coordinates against the pinned geometry profile tolerance and browser screenshot/DOM evidence. Use a scroll/zoom viewport on narrow screens; do not rearrange the canonical circuit into cards.
semanticChecks.visualQuality: At each required viewport every required control is reachable by documented scroll/navigation, has nonzero rendered bounds, is not clipped/occluded when brought into view, passes pointer hit-test, and has visible keyboard focus. Record browser event receipt using performance.now and first compositor-presented frame containing the corresponding state using browser tracing; report event-to-paint <=1000 ms under the pinned workload/environment. If no presentation timestamp is observable, evidence is INCONCLUSIVE rather than substituting DOM update time.
semanticChecks.sourceAttempts: Retain SourceAttempt records with page cursor, attempt/time, response status, rate-limit retry bound and resolved version/digest. Conflicting versions produce an OPEN finding and prevent COMPLETE ranking until an explicit new source revision or pinned resolution is verified. Prove attempts and elapsed deadlines from attributed receipts.
semanticChecks.modelEvidence: DecisionProposal references ModelExecutionEvidence carrying exact input and response artifact digests, declared provider/model/profile, uncertainty/escalation and available metrics. Unavailable metrics are null with a reason. The output digest hashes a separate raw response artifact, not the containing receipt.
semanticChecks.generationProvenance: ArtifactBundle references GenerationProvenance with actual generator capability/declaration, run/step/attempt, input digests and artifact output digests. Independently join the invocation recording and stored bytes. A generationMethod label cannot prove agency; initial and maintenance journeys must demonstrate admitted OV3 generation with no frontier implementation substitution.
